prediction.prediction: ENG3 RVAs 0x1f8e0, 0x1f910, 0x1f920, 0x1f930, 0x1f940, 0x1f980, 0x1f9e0, 0x1f9f0, 0x1fa20, 0x1fa50, and 0x1fa70 are first-party one-call wrappers over the shared 250-word engine interface at VA 0x100407a0. Their call-site stack setup and existing shared-header callback prototypes support ordinary typed C. Under pinned VC5 /O2, the non-padding instruction streams should match the target, each contribution should carry exactly one DIR32 relocation through the same external interface symbol, and the implied address should be 0x100407a0. A strict function match is not predicted because the target imports contain absolute relocations to the copied interface slots.
prediction.falsifier: Any target body whose argument count, slot offset, return use, or tail-call shape conflicts with the shared header and TITLE wrapper evidence; any non-padding instruction mismatch; differing relocation topology or implied base across wrappers; or a compiler contribution whose complete extent cannot be defended from the target bytes.
